title: You, Me and God — Sunday post
hook: Three things that have never once let me down.
body:
Wrote You, Me and God about the short list that actually holds a life together. If it's your kind of song, turn it up this morning and share it with somebody who'd get it.

Off the We're All Here record. Grateful for every one of you.
cta: Turn it up and tag somebody who needs to hear it.
media_notes: A warm portrait or a simple lyric card works. Keep it sincere — never preachy.
visual_headline: Three things that have never once let me down.
